description: Achievement definitions. type is one of: sessions, cleanSessionStreak, comebacks, streakDays (longest day streak), bestExerciseTier (0=Iron, 1=Bronze, 2=Silver, 3=Gold, 4=Platinum, 5=Emerald, 6=Diamond, 7=Master, 8=Grandmaster, 9=Challenger), discipline (% over 30 days, needs 50+ sets), prs, totalVolumeKg, level. Unlocked when the metric >= threshold.
